Given: M + Q – R + K – Y

It means: M is the mother of Q, Q is the brother of R, R is the mother of K and K is the brother of Y.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/055fe11506e2d7c654f4cd0e7312ca46a67740c6dd1f14d4a417a12eece3df68.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f5eb65ccb05f0476834143780c758ab8a05b4c99168e92cca01230b51bfe8689.png] 

So, M is the** Mother’s mother** of Y.

Hence, the correct answer is "Mother’s mother".
